description: This file defines the 'Leaderboard' page logic for the OnlineExamSystem web application. It handles user session validation, retrieves user-specific data from the database, and defines navigation controls for the page.

classes.name: Leaderboard
classes.description: Code-behind class for the Leaderboard ASP.NET page, handling page load events and button click navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; checks user session, retrieves user info from database, and saves the semester year to session.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for home button; navigates to Dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for profile button; navigates to User Profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for leaderboard button; currently empty.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by resetting session ID and redirects to login page.
